rows.Assessment: Overly permissive permissions should not be configured on Function App, Web App or Logic App
Web Application should only be accessible over HTTPS
CORS should not allow every resource to access Web Applications
Remote debugging should be turned off for Web Applications

comparison: Actual app/WAF source evidence independently available without Defender, versus actual observations under the enabled Defender plans. Not a Defender-disabled control run.

classifications.application: Actual ingestion of explicitly synthetic fixtures, not process execution, outbound connections or compromise.
classifications.waf: Actual custom-rule matches. Block with Detection and HTTP 200 is not enforced blocking or CVE protection.
classifications.defenderAlerts: Actual provider alerts only, exact-app/time-window correlation does not establish fixture causality.
classifications.missing: Unavailable and not-yet-observed evidence are not successful detections or proof of safety.

publication: Sanitized, static snapshot requiring manual review; no live workspace or privileged API is exposed.
